verdict.rationale: The pack shows per-minute billing and a view-only monthly Usage page, but nothing about auto-shutdown timers, idle detection, or spend caps. A community report describes a forgotten GH200 instance billing $583 over 391 hours, with support confirming Lambda does not distinguish idle from in-use instances. That is consistent with the capability being absent. Users could script their own termination via cloud-init or the Cloud API, but that is a self-built workaround, not a product feature.
